ths.text: Daxos of Meletis is revealed to be an oracle when Lidia takes him to Athreos, and Erebos sends Athreos to claim him, until Lidia trades herself for her son and Karametra's emissary takes Daxos to safety.
Elspeth and Daxos arrive in Akros, besieged by Mogis's minotaurs, where Elspeth defeats the hydra Polukranos with Daxos's help and becomes Heliod's champion, and Daxos names her Champion of Heliod.
They confess their love, but Xenagos forces Elspeth to relive her trauma and she kills Daxos.

Elspeth asks Erebos to trade her soul for Daxos's, and he agrees, but Heliod resurrects Daxos as a demigod and champion and has him remove all trace of the other gods from Meletis, starting a war of the gods.
